text.en: For the Tamils, bulls stand for courage, harvest and wealth.

Yeru Thazhuvuthal, the embracing of the bull, is an ancient sport of the Mullai and Marutham regions that became part of Tamil culture. The prose lesson explains that cattle are symbols of bravery, harvest, prosperity and wealth for Tamils.
The sport shows the courage of young men and the closeness between farmers and their cattle. It is described in Sangam literature and is a part of Tamil heritage.
Terms: ஏறு (bull), தழுவுதல் (to embrace), முல்லை and மருதம் (landscapes), பண்பாடு (culture) and வீரம் (bravery).
